events.title: US Existing Home Sales (July)
events.why_it_matters: Housing market health indicator; affects mortgage demand, consumer sentiment, and construction-related sectors.
events.what_to_watch: Month-over-month sales change, median home prices, inventory levels, and regional divergences.

events.title: Eurozone Flash PMI (August)
events.why_it_matters: Early gauge of Eurozone economic momentum; influences ECB policy expectations and EUR/USD.
events.what_to_watch: Composite PMI vs. consensus, manufacturing vs. services divergence, price pressures embedded in the data.

events.title: China Activity Data (July)
events.why_it_matters: Key read on Chinese domestic demand and industrial output; affects global commodity prices and EM equities.
events.what_to_watch: Retail sales, industrial production, fixed asset investment, and whether policy stimulus is gaining traction.

events.title: US Q2 GDP Second Estimate
events.why_it_matters: Confirms US growth trajectory; revisions can shift Fed rate expectations and risk appetite.
events.what_to_watch: GDP growth revision vs. advance estimate, consumption, business investment, and inflation components (GDP deflator).

events.title: Section 232 drone tariffs (up to 100%)
events.why_it_matters: Trump signed a proclamation imposing up to 100% tariffs on imported drones/components under Section 232, effective Sept 3, escalating US-China tech decoupling.
events.what_to_watch: Legal challenges, allied exemptions (EU 15%, UK 10%, Korea 15%), and domestic drone supply-chain buildout.

events.title: 25 states sue over new tariffs
events.why_it_matters: 25 Democratic-led states sued the administration over the latest global tariff round, calling it a pretext to replace duties the Supreme Court struck down in February.
events.what_to_watch: Whether courts enjoin the new tariffs and the trajectory of the trade-policy fight.

events.title: SEC cancels Regulation Crypto meeting
events.why_it_matters: SEC postponed its long-awaited Reg Crypto proposal open meeting without a new date, delaying a framework that would reshape US digital-asset oversight.
events.what_to_watch: Rescheduling of the meeting and White House/SIFMA involvement in the rulemaking.

events.title: Childhood vaccine executive order
events.why_it_matters: Trump signed an EO urging fewer and spaced-out childhood vaccines (separating MMR), citing discredited autism claims.
events.what_to_watch: CDC guidance remains unchanged; agency and legal pushback on implementation.

events.title: Federal judge blocks mail-in voting EO
events.why_it_matters: A Boston federal judge expanded a nationwide block on USPS implementing Trump's mail-in voting executive order; the administration asked the Supreme Court to intervene.
events.what_to_watch: Supreme Court emergency application and impact on 2026 midterm election procedures.

events.title: OFAC sanctions action
events.why_it_matters: Treasury OFAC blocked property of designated persons under sanctions authorities, published in the Federal Register Aug 14.
events.what_to_watch: Specific targets and any sector implications from the designations.

events.title: CLARITY Act Senate vote scheduled
events.why_it_matters: Senate Majority Leader Thune confirmed a floor vote on the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act before recess, but stablecoin/ethics disputes pushed cloture to September.
events.what_to_watch: 60-vote cloture threshold and whether the bill advances to reshape crypto oversight.

events.title: UMich consumer sentiment (prelim August)
events.why_it_matters: UMich sentiment fell to 51.0 from 55.2, the first drop in three months, with 1-yr inflation expectations rising to 4.3%.
events.what_to_watch: Inflation expectations component and implications for Fed rate path.

events.title: US retail sales (July)
events.why_it_matters: Retail sales fell 0.6% m/m in July, the biggest drop in over a year, missing expectations as consumers pulled back.
events.what_to_watch: Consumer spending trajectory and recession signals.

events.title: Weekly jobless claims
events.why_it_matters: Initial jobless claims rose to 209K vs 202K expected, though the 4-week average held at 199K.
events.what_to_watch: Labor market cooling signals and Fed implications.

events.title: EIA crude oil inventories
events.why_it_matters: US commercial crude inventories rose 17.4M barrels, a large build that pressured oil prices.
events.what_to_watch: Oil price direction and OPEC+ response.

events.title: EIA natural gas storage / winter outlook
events.why_it_matters: Working gas rose 36 Bcf to 3,153 Bcf; EIA expects the highest natural gas inventories in a decade heading into winter.
events.what_to_watch: Natural gas price pressure from ample storage.

events.title: Applied Materials Q3 earnings
events.why_it_matters: AMAT reported record results and guided 30%+ semiconductor equipment growth for 2026 on AI data-center buildouts.
events.what_to_watch: Semiconductor equipment cycle strength and AI capex signals.

events.title: Taiwan Han Kuang military drills
events.why_it_matters: Taiwan deployed attack-drone swarms and missile boats in annual Han Kuang exercises amid a sharpened China invasion threat.
events.what_to_watch: PLA response and Taiwan Strait escalation risk.

events.title: FOMC minutes (July 29 meeting)
events.why_it_matters: FOMC minutes could clarify the hawkish shift; markets price ~31% chance of a September rate hike, down from 55% a week earlier.
events.what_to_watch: Signals on the rate path and inflation concerns.

events.title: US housing starts (July)
events.why_it_matters: Housing starts/permits data will gauge the housing recovery amid elevated mortgage rates.
events.what_to_watch: Permits vs starts divergence and housing-sector momentum.

top_risks: Eurozone PMI misses could reignite recession fears and pressure EUR.
China activity data weakness may signal global demand slowdown.
US housing market deterioration could weigh on consumer confidence.
Q2 GDP downward revision could complicate Fed messaging.
top_opportunities: Eurozone PMI beat could lift cyclical sectors and EUR.
China data showing stabilization could boost EM and commodity plays.
US housing resilience would support rate-sensitive sectors.
GDP upside surprise could strengthen USD and risk-on sentiment.
summary: Today's US existing home sales data and tomorrow's Eurozone flash PMI are the near-term macro catalysts. China's activity data from earlier this week remains a lingering risk factor. The US Q2 GDP second estimate at month-end will be a key confirmation point. Markets are likely to remain data-dependent with moderate uncertainty.

catcher.coverage_assessment: The primary scan was extremely thin, tracking only 4 macro data events and completely missing the government action space (Section 232 drone tariffs, executive orders, judicial rulings, SEC actions) that dominated the window, plus several high-impact macro releases (UMich sentiment, retail sales) and a major semiconductor earnings report.
catcher.biggest_gap: The Section 232 drone tariffs (up to 100%, signed Aug 13, effective Sept 3) — a major trade-policy action with direct sector impact and China-decoupling implications that the primary entirely missed.
